summary: the largest time step the Courant condition allows on a grid

inputs.name: courant_limit
inputs.meaning: the Courant number the scheme is run below; a judgement, bound to a row with its own source

inputs.name: cell_size
inputs.meaning: the smallest cell of the grid along the flow

inputs.name: velocity
inputs.meaning: the largest velocity expected in the domain

outputs.name: time_step_max
outputs.meaning: the upper bound on the time step from the Courant condition

validity: explicit or semi-implicit advection on a grid; the limit itself depends on the scheme and is an input

source.citation: R. Courant, K. Friedrichs, H. Lewy, Über die partiellen Differenzengleichungen der mathematischen Physik, Mathematische Annalen 100 (1928)
source.locus: the condition that the numerical domain of dependence contains the physical one: time step <= C * cell size / velocity
